arxiv-2108-01233.title: Design and Evaluation of a Hair Combing System Using a General-Purpose Robotic Arm
arxiv-2108-01233.creator: Nathaniel Dennler, Eura Shin, Maja Matarić, Stefanos Nikolaidis
arxiv-2108-01233.description: Abstract This work introduces an approach for automatic hair combing by a lightweight robot. For people living with limited mobility, dexterity, or chronic fatigue, combing hair is often a difficult task that negatively impacts personal routines. We propose a modular system for enabling general robot manipulators to assist with a hair-combing task. The system consists of three main components.

arxiv-2201-11872.title: Local Latent Space Bayesian Optimization over Structured Inputs
arxiv-2201-11872.creator: Natalie T. Maus, Haydn T. Jones, Juston S. Moore, Matt J. Kusner, John Bradshaw, Jacob R. Gardner
arxiv-2201-11872.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization over the latent spaces of deep autoencoder models (DAEs) has recently emerged as a promising new approach for optimizing challenging black-box functions over structured, discrete, hard-to-enumerate search spaces (e.g., molecules). Here the DAE dramatically simplifies the search space by mapping inputs into a continuous latent space where familiar Bayesian optimization tools can be more readily applied.

arxiv-2203-00201.title: RMBR: A Regularized Minimum Bayes Risk Reranking Framework for Machine Translation
arxiv-2203-00201.creator: Yidan Zhang, Yu Wan, Dayiheng Liu, Baosong Yang, Zhenan He
arxiv-2203-00201.description: Abstract Beam search is the most widely used decoding method for neural machine translation (NMT). In practice, the top-1 candidate with the highest log-probability among the n n candidates is selected as the ‘preferred’ one. However, this top-1 candidate may not be the best overall translation among the n n -best list.

arxiv-2209-07941.title: Random covers of compact surfaces and smooth linear spectral statistics
arxiv-2209-07941.creator: By Frédéric Naud
arxiv-2209-07941.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by By Frédéric Naud. We consider random n n -covers X n X_{n} of an arbitrary compact hyperbolic surface X X . We show that in the large n n regime and small window limit, the variance of the smooth spectral statistics of the Laplacian Δ ρ \Delta_{\rho} twisted by a unitary abelian character, obey the universal laws of GOE and GUE random matrices, depending on wether the character ρ \rho preserves or breaks the time reversal symmetry.

arxiv-2301-07881.title: Polynomial Furstenberg joinings and its applications Thanks: This research is supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China (12031019, 12090012, 11971455, 11731003).
arxiv-2301-07881.creator: Wen Huang, Song Shao, Xiangdong Ye
arxiv-2301-07881.description: Abstract . In this paper, a polynomial version of Furstenberg joining is introduced and its structure is investigated. Particularly, it is shown that if all polynomials are non-linear, then almost every ergodic component of the joining is a direct product of an infinity-step pro-nilsystem and a Bernoulli system. As applications, some new convergence theorems are obtained.

arxiv-2310-14050.title: Code-Switching with Word Senses for Pretraining in Neural Machine Translation
arxiv-2310-14050.creator: Vivek Iyer, Edoardo Barba, Alexandra Birch, Jeff Z. Pan, Roberto Navigli
arxiv-2310-14050.description: Abstract Lexical ambiguity is a significant and pervasive challenge in Neural Machine Translation (NMT), with many state-of-the-art (SOTA) NMT systems struggling to handle polysemous words ( Campolungo et al. 2022a ) . The same holds for the NMT pretraining paradigm of denoising synthetic “code-switched” text ( Pan et al. 2021 ; Iyer et al.

arxiv-2408-06358.title: How good nnU-Net for Segmenting Cardiac MRI: A Comprehensive Evaluation
arxiv-2408-06358.creator: Malitha Gunawardhana, Fangqiang Xu, Jichao Zhao
arxiv-2408-06358.description: Abstract Background Cardiac segmentation is a critical process in medical imaging, providing a detailed analysis of heart structures that is essential for the diagnosis and treatment of various cardiovascular diseases. The advent of deep learning has revolutionized this field by introducing automated segmentation techniques that significantly outperform traditional manual methods in terms of both accuracy and efficiency.

arxiv-2409-08836.title: Thermoelectrical potential and derivation of Kelvin relation for thermoelectric materials
arxiv-2409-08836.creator: Si-Kun Chen, Hong-Xin Zhu, Hai-Dong Wang, Zeng-Yuan Guo
arxiv-2409-08836.description: Abstract Current research on thermoelectricity is primarily focused on the exploration of materials with enhanced performance, resulting in a lack of fundamental understanding of the thermoelectric effect. Such circumstance is not conducive to the further improvement of the efficiency of thermoelectric conversion. Moreover, available physical images of the derivation of the Kelvin relations are ambiguous.

arxiv-2410-21329.title: CloudCast – Total Cloud Cover Nowcasting with Machine Learning
arxiv-2410-21329.description: Abstract Cloud cover plays a critical role in weather prediction and impacts several sectors, including agriculture, solar power generation, and aviation. Despite advancements in numerical weather prediction (NWP) models, forecasting total cloud cover remains challenging due to the small-scale nature of cloud formation processes.

arxiv-2503-08167.creator: Salvatore Capozziello 1,2,3, Sara Cesare 2,3, Carmen Ferrara 2,3
arxiv-2503-08167.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Salvatore Capozziello 1,2,3, Sara Cesare 2,3, Carmen Ferrara 2,3. arxiv-2505-11545.title: TARGET: Benchmarking Table Retrieval for Generative Tasks
arxiv-2505-11545.creator: Xingyu Ji, Parker Glenn, Aditya G. Parameswaran, Madelon Hulsebos
arxiv-2505-11545.description: Abstract The data landscape is rich with structured data, often of high value to organizations, driving important applications in data analysis and machine learning. Recent progress in representation learning and generative models for such data has led to the development of natural language interfaces to structured data, including those leveraging text-to-SQL.

arxiv-2506-08849.title: Adapting Vision-Language Foundation Model for Next Generation Medical Ultrasound Image Analysis
arxiv-2506-08849.creator: Jingguo Qu, Xinyang Han, Tonghuan Xiao, Jia Ai, Juan Wu, Tong Zhao, Jing Qin, Ann Dorothy King, Winnie Chiu-Wing Chu, Jing Cai, Michael Tin-Cheung Ying
arxiv-2506-08849.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jingguo Qu, Xinyang Han, Tonghuan Xiao, Jia Ai, Juan Wu, Tong Zhao, Jing Qin, Ann Dorothy King, Winnie Chiu-Wing Chu, Jing Cai, Michael Tin-Cheung Ying. Medical ultrasonography is an essential imaging technique for examining superficial organs and tissues, including lymph nodes, breast, and thyroid. It employs high-frequency ultrasound waves to generate detailed images of the internal structures of the human body.

arxiv-2511-18699.title: Dendritic Convolution for Noise Image Recognition
arxiv-2511-18699.creator: Jiarui Xue, Dongjian Yang, Ye Sun, Gang Liu*
arxiv-2511-18699.description: Abstract In real-world scenarios of image recognition, there exists substantial noise interference. Existing works primarily focus on methods such as adjusting networks or training strategies to address noisy image recognition, and the anti-noise performance has reached a bottleneck. However, little is known about the exploration of anti-interference solutions from a neuronal perspective.This paper proposes an anti-noise neuronal convolution.

europmc-pmc6794619.creator: Kim H, Wang SY, Kwak G, Yang Y, Kwon IC, Kim SH.

pmc-10626660.title: Current status and influencing factors of policy identification in health impact assessment: a case study of Zhejiang Province
pmc-10626660.creator: Xiang Liu, Yingzi Liu, Yanyun Xu, Liyuan Song, Ziyue Huang, Xingyu Zhu, Meng Zhang
pmc-10626660.description: BackgroundHealth impact assessment (HIA) is a procedure, method and tool for evaluating the potential health impacts of policies, plans and construction projects, as well as the distribution of these impacts on population. Majority of international studies on health impact assessment have focussed on conceptual papers or case evaluations, neglecting participants’ views on policies.

pmc-10644299.title: Limitation of Non-Beneficial Interventions and their Impact on the Intensive Care Unit Costs
pmc-10644299.creator: Sotiria Koutsouki, Dimitrios Kosmidis, Eva-Otilia Nagy, Alexandra Tsaroucha, Georgios Anastasopoulos, Ioannis Pnevmatikos, Vasileios Papaioannou
pmc-10644299.description: IntroductionUsing a plan to limit non-beneficial life support interventions has significantly reduced harm and loss of dignity for patients at the end of life. The association of these limitations with patients’ clinical characteristics and health care costs in the intensive care unit (ICU) needs further scientific evidence.

pmc-11547108.title: Hemoperfusion with CytoSorb® in Pediatric Patients: A Monocentric Case Series
pmc-11547108.creator: Eva Rihar, Vanja Peršič, Alexander Jerman, Tina Plankar Srovin, Gorazd Mlakar, Neva Bezeljak, Marko Pokorn, Petja Fister, Janet Hume
pmc-11547108.description: Background: Pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines help regulate the inflammatory response. A cytokine storm is a dysregulated cytokine response associated with sepsis and other conditions that result in a hyper-inflammatory state. Extracorporeal cytokine adsorption has the potential to restore a balanced inflammatory response.

pmc-12663207.title: Efficacy, safety, and predictive biomarkers of neoadjuvant nab-paclitaxel and pembrolizumab in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer: A randomized pilot trial
pmc-12663207.creator: Adrienne G Waks, Jingxin Fu, Xiangying Chu, Busem Binboga Kurt, Tianyu Li, Thomas M Kuntz, Yizhuo Shen, David Yang, Kevin Meli, Brendan Reardon, Jihye Park, Ann Partridge, Daniel Abravanel, Rinath Jeselsohn, Eileen Wrabel, Jillian Alberti, Molly DiLullo, Serenity Chen, Ayesha Mohammed-Abreu, Xiaopen
pmc-12663207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Patients with hormone receptor-positive (HR + )/HER2- breast cancer may benefit from neoadjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) plus chemotherapy. The effect of chemotherapy or ICI run-in before combination therapy in this population is unexplored. In this randomized pilot trial, patients with HR + /HER2- breast cancer received two weeks of neoadjuvant nab-paclitaxel or pembrolizumab, with baseline and post-run-in tumor biopsy, followed by combined nab-paclitaxel/pembrolizumab. The primary endpoint was PD-L1 expression change between biopsies. Tumor whole exome/RNA sequencing were performed.

pmc-12787787.title: Subcellular Localization Dictates Therapeutic Function: Spatially Targeted Delivery of Amuc_1100 by Engineered Lacticaseibacillus paracasei L9 Enhances Intestinal Barrier in Colitis
pmc-12787787.creator: Xinrui Dong, Li Lin, Weina Miao, Zhengyuan Zhai, Yanling Hao, Ming Zhang, Ran Wang, Shaoyang Ge, Hao Zhang, Lianzhong Ai, Liang Zhao
pmc-12787787.description: Background/Objectives: Impaired intestinal barrier function is a hallmark of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Akkermansia muciniphila and its outer membrane protein Amuc_1100 can enhance this barrier, but the clinical application of Amuc_1100 is limited by the fastidious growth of its native host. This study aimed to overcome this by utilizing the robust probiotic Lacticaseibacillus paracasei L9 for targeted Amuc_1100 delivery.

pmc-13192016.title: Use of M-CHAT for autism screening in well-baby clinics of a primary health care center in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia: a retrospective cross-sectional study
pmc-13192016.creator: Razan Z. AlShammari, Maha A. AlMuraisel
pmc-13192016.description: BackgroundAutism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition in which early identification and intervention significantly improve developmental outcomes. The Modified Checklist for Autism in Toddlers, Revised with Follow-Up (M-CHAT-R/F), is commonly used in primary care settings for early screening; however, real-world data on its performance in Saudi primary care, particularly within military healthcare systems, remain limited.

pmc-13367469.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of the Depression Anxiety Stress Scale for Youth (DASS-Y) Indonesian Version for Screening Internalizing Disorders Among Adolescents
pmc-13367469.creator: Andra Kurnianto, Meita Dhamayanti, Rodman Tarigan Girsang, Eddy Fadlyana, Kusnandi Rusmil, Mei Neni Sitaresmi, Bintang Arroyantri Prananjaya
pmc-13367469.description: BackgroundAs adolescent mental health issues are increasingly recognized as a public health concern, evaluating the accuracy of the DASS-Y is important for early detection and intervention. This study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of the Indonesian version of the DASS-Y in screening internalizing disorders among adolescents aged 10–18 years.
